name: honda_k20a_dc5
source: Engine garage P9: Honda K20A, JDM Integra Type R (DC5, 2001) - a 2.0 L DOHC i-VTEC I4 with two-profile VTEC on intake and exhaust, as a lumped cycle-model description; every runtime map is GENERATED at load, one complete set per cam profile (cam part ../cams/honda_k20a_dc5_vtec.json, switching rule in ../ecus/honda_k20a_dc5.json). Cited: bore x stroke 86.0 x 86.0 mm, 1998 cm3, compression ratio 11.5, 162 kW (220 PS) at 8000 rpm and 206 N*m at 7000 rpm net, VTEC switch 6000 rpm, maximum permitted speed 8400 rpm, throttle bore 62 mm - Honda Integra fact book 2001.07 p.07 (https://www.honda.co.jp/factbook/auto/INTEGRA/200107/07.html); DOHC 4 valves per cylinder, VTEC on intake and exhaust (https://www.honda.co.jp/sportscar/vtec_history/K20A/). Rod 139 mm and intake valve 35 mm are vendor listings (sources at the keys). Cam lifts, runner, ports, plenum, spark, lambda, friction and the rest are [AS] or rules copied from engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json; nothing is fitted to the published ratings (the torque/power comparison is reported, tests/unit/test_cam_profiles.cpp). VTC (50 deg intake phasing) is not modelled - fixed cams.
geometry_source: [C] bore 86.0 mm, stroke 86.0 mm, 1998 cm3, 4 cylinders: Honda Integra fact book 2001.07 p.07 (https://www.honda.co.jp/factbook/auto/INTEGRA/200107/07.html).
intake_manifold_volume_source: [AS] plenum = 1.2 x V_d (1.99822 L), the i7c plan rule used for the A25A (engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json); no K20A plenum volume found.
throttle_body_source: [C] throttle bore 62 mm, Honda Integra fact book 2001.07 p.07 (same URL as the source). [AS] discharge coefficient 0.8 and the area-fraction curve copied from engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json.
throttle_input_source: [AS] electronic (the DC5's throttle actuation was not checked; a mechanical linkage needs an idle bypass model).

cycle.source: Engine garage P9: lumped (no pipe blocks) C15a cycle description of the Honda K20A (DC5); per-key sources below. The cam lifts come from the cam part (two VTEC profiles).
cycle.rod_mm_source: [C, vendor] 139 mm (138.98 mm / 5.470 in) centre-to-centre: aftermarket replacement-rod listings for K20A/A2/Z1 (https://www.hybrid-racing.com/products/speedfactory-h-beam-connecting-rods-k20a-k20z), stock length as the replacement's; l/r = 3.23.
cycle.intake_valve_d_mm_source: intake 35 mm [C, vendor]: Brian Crower K20A replacement intake valve listing (https://www.jdmgarageuk.com/bc3040.html; the listing does not say it is the stock size); exhaust 30 mm [AS] (the commonly quoted figure, not verified; 30/35 = 0.857).
cycle.runner_length_mm_source: [AS] the A25A rule (engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json): quarter-wave period 4L/a = the intake-open time of the high cam (290 deg) at 7000 rpm, the cited peak-torque speed [C] (fact book), a = 340.29 m/s -> L = 587.4 mm. Diameter: runner flow area = the total intake valve head area (2 x 35 mm heads -> 49.50 mm) [AS]. No K20A runner length is published (the PRC manifold is described as a single-stage short-runner design only by uncited secondary sources).
cycle.intake_port_cc_source: [AS] the A25A rule: 80 mm x the total intake valve head area (1924.2 mm2); 250 mm x the total exhaust valve head area (1413.7 mm2).
cycle.cd_vs_l_over_d_source: [AS] copied from engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json (Heywood 1988 Fig. 6-19 shape, recalled).
cycle.wiebe_source: Tier 2: Wiebe a 5, m 2 (Heywood 1988 sec. 9.2.1); CA50 at MBT 8 deg ATDC (plan D11 MBT rule). Burn duration and ignition delay: the burn law (design C, owner decision 2026-10-19, vault PHYS-079; ps/engine_cycle/burn_law.h, data/burn_laws/default.json) sets both per cycle from the cycle's own IVC state; at the law's reference state they are the C17a [D] values 40.3205 / 3.8632 deg derived from MIT 2.61 lecture 9 (vault PHYS-055), which this file carried as constants before the law.
cycle.friction_source: [AS] the F4 FMEP polynomial of engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json (fitted on a third engine, the EPA 2013 Ecotec LCV motored rows) applied unchanged; the K20A's 8400 rpm (24.1 m/s mean piston speed) is beyond that fit's measured range.
cycle.grid_source: [AS] idle to the 8400 rpm limit with nodes at the switch band (5800/6000/6200); 20-100 kPa.

fields_source: [AS] inertia 0.12 kg*m^2; breakaway 30 N*m (>= the F4 friction at rest, 10.6 N*m); the starter as engines/toyota_a25a_fks_gen.json. The state-machine speeds live in the ECU part.
fuels_source: [AS] EN 228 E5/E10 stand-ins (the JDM car runs Japanese premium, 100 RON; no such fuel file exists).
